claims.exact_statement: For rank-r Boolean point defects, the complete signed node coefficient required when every surviving coordinate is retained in the orbit block is 4r-3+4/ln(2)+o(1). Consequently no fixed c can make the repeated full-block history policy SOLD on all ranks.
hypotheses: full inherited block at every nonconstant node

claims.exact_statement: For c0=14+4/ln(2), every finite-rank Boolean one-point defect has a complete adapted signed-orbit restriction tree of physical history width at most two, using transitions {x,y}->{y,z} above rank two and direct endpoint transitions at ranks two and one. Hence G<=(16+4/ln(2))I and H<=(34+8/ln(2))I on this family.
claims.first_unproved_line: Universal width-two query/entering-coordinate selection for an arbitrary Boolean core.
